purpose: diagnosis of the E1-P moves S400 played that the depth-2 truth check left UNKNOWN in TB-V3-BUDGET-1; no games, no deployment decision; the END of TB-V3-BUDGET-1 stays

replay.label_rule: e1_evaluate.evaluate_position: a truth of the manifest first, a missing move at B0
replay.diagnostic_recheck: the first candidate and the final move of every run at B0 again (lost_depth_info), kept apart from the labels
replay.judgement: AGGREGATE_REPRODUCED when the E1-P outcome counts equal the expected ones, else NOT_REPRODUCED; never a claim about the same position, seed or move
replay.not_reproduced: deepen goes on with this replay's UNKNOWN moves

deepen.order: S400 unresolved runs first (first candidate, then final move), then every other UNKNOWN move; per move B1, B2, B3
deepen.timeout: the task runs in its own process, killed at the limit: TIMEOUT (apart from a solver UNKNOWN); past the total: NOT_RUN

reading.per_move: B1 / B2 / B3 each: PROVEN_LOSS, VCT2_CLEAR, UNKNOWN, TIMEOUT or NOT_RUN, with the stop reasons

resolved_by.B1 only: raising the single VCF call limit was enough
resolved_by.B2 only: raising the per-move totals was enough
resolved_by.B3 only: only with both raised (of the tested combinations)
resolved_by.B1 and B2: either raise was enough: no single cause
resolved_by.incomplete: a TIMEOUT or NOT_RUN: no cause

use: PROVEN_LOSS among S400's failure moves: a real loss within depth 2; with its run's simulation mode (tactical 800 grounds a separate normal 400 / tactical 100 comparison)
all VCT2_CLEAR: the B0 limits made them UNKNOWN; no loss within depth 2 only
reading.scope: VCT2_CLEAR means no loss within depth 2, never a good move; the END of TB-V3-BUDGET-1 stays; a deployment review is a new contract with a pre-fixed tactical rule and a new tactical sample

stages.deepen: the larger budgets and the report
